## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit, and integration where a dependency is touched)
- [ ] Docs updated (guides, `config.example.yaml`, error registry as needed)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` entry added
- [ ] New dependency checklist recorded (maintained, allowed license, no GPL/AGPL)
- [ ] `make lint test test-integration` passes
- [ ] Commit messages follow `<type>(<scope>): <summary>`
